verdict.rationale: Docs describe the Checkout API flow (sessions/paymentMethods/payments), webhooks, testing, idempotency, and SDK support for web/iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter, suggesting a documented integration path, but no evidence shows concrete copy-paste code snippets per language or a 'day-one' quickstart. Multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict an easy, fast integration: one team reported 'hundreds of hours invested' before ditching Adyen, others say 'Stripe beats Adyen on ease of integration hands down' and that integration complexity keeps startups on competitors, while one consultant found it 'not as terrible as many make it seem.' missing for 10: language-specific copy-paste code samples, an explicit quickstart/time-to-integrate benchmark, and resolution of the conflicting hands-on integration-time reports.
